export_evidence: importkey.com/countries/india/bs-foods-and-beverages (also slugs 'bs-foods-beverages' and 'bs-foods-and-beverages-pvt-ltd') returned only the generic page shell: 'Shipments available for BS FOODS AND BEVERAGES, refreshed daily' — a boilerplate sentence, with zero shipment rows, zero dates, zero destinations, zero HS codes and zero B/L numbers rendered. Source counter: 3 importkey URL variants tried, 0 shipment records actually seen. volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no second-source rows could be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report split could be located. Bing queries for '"BS Foods and Beverages" India GST OR exporter OR shipment' and '"BS Foods & Beverages" India company' returned only generic dictionary/acronym results for 'BS' (merriam-webster, wikipedia, acronymfinder) — 0 company-specific hits. DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint timed out; the web_search tool returned 'no results (searx: Connection refused)'.
